title: Developer Mode Gatekeeping (Report -> Review -> Manual Approval)
rule_statement: The agent is in developer mode and is strictly forbidden from editing ANY file until a comprehensive diagnostic report/plan is presented and the user explicitly grants manual approval in the subsequent prompt.
user_quotes: I want you to be in developer mode, but you are not allowed to edit a single file unles you make the report and i approved it manually in the next prompt, if i need any change any information or have any question with you plan/suggestion i will ask the you need to answer it/change/update it etc as per requirements and then wait for the approval. You ar ein no capcity allowed to self-approve and start editing the py files.
enforcement_mechanism: Audit every file-write operation. If an unapproved write is detected, abort immediately and prompt for review.
